prerequisites: Competencies taught in the advanced modules (topic-dependent) are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: have in-depth knowledge and skills in a selected specialized area of computer science
can report on current research results and deal with research literature

can apply working methods from computer science for the selected specialized area of computer science (developing and applying fundamental solution strategies and their formal description, training abstract thinking, system development)
are able to apply scientific working methods when independently solving problems and communicating the solution
have acquired competencies preferably from the field of technical computer science

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions to at least two exercise assignments
Written exam or oral exam (individual exam)

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution to at least two of the exercise assignments. The final grade is based on a written exam or an individual oral examination, with grading from 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science degree program.
